_source: Model groups for the Aircall LLM Gateway (llmgateway.io). Prices come from pricing.json. Checked 2026-09-23.
_note: Ids are what the gateway accepts as the Anthropic-compatible 'model' field. A '<provider>/' prefix pins the provider (fireworks/… is what aircode uses); a bare id lets the gateway pick the provider. If a bare id is rejected, pin it with the provider shown in the gateway model list.

cheap.use: search, listings, lookups, routine edits, subagents by default

mid.use: implementation with some ambiguity, medium refactors, plans that are not architecture

strong.use: architecture, adversarial review, concurrency, migrations, subtle root causes
